question: Which mechanisms of writing, holding and switching does the dissipative cat qubit (two-photon loss) carry, and with which laws?

provenance.source: Mirrahimi et al., New J. Phys. 16, 045014 (2014); Lescanne et al., Nat. Phys. 16, 509 (2020)
provenance.kind: authored quantum carrier (mean field + vacuum noise of the loss channel, truncated Wigner)

name: dissipative cat qubit (two-photon loss)

carrier.name: quadratures x, y of the mode amplitude

closure: engineered two-photon loss kappa2 D[a^2 - A] and single-photon loss kappa1; noise of both channels approximated as additive, D ~ (kappa1 + kappa2 A)/8 at A ~ 3
assumptions: mean field of the two-photon dissipation
